content: Madiyakyaka mi newek Makromod Yesus mai wali'ur
Ai walin na'ahoru, lolo horok eniyeni ka'u wakunu panaeku ma na'ono ma'anana Yesus wali wali'ur mai noho wawan,
ono mi mehe mauroinedi mouropo nahenia Yesus Nin mamai onne naise ri ma nodi a'alam mai namna'a.

Ler onne ri na'aheni, “Ha wo'ire na'akeme wa'an ra'a, namlina namkaiyedi me'e.” Maa lere onne penia ha man sus narehi duni ta'al ri mormori noho wawan, la ri mahaku kan lernala leken suwar nano dunduni ta'ata'al onne. Mamlilinnohi ha onne namwali naise maeke ma nornoro raramne lernala apinpinha leke karuwana.
Enimaa mi ka mamwali man minle metmetek kalkale, de mi ka mahumarna, kade mamlilinnohi Makromod Yesus mai wali'ur naise ri man mai namna'a.
Ai walin na'ahoru, ik kak minle metmetek kalkala me'e. Ik kak hi'i wewhe naise ri man holi a'alam, maa ik minle ropropeni la hi'i wewhe naise ri man holi lelere.
Ende, yono kaise ri ma namkukuru mamani ono minle metmetek, maa kadiyakyaka ika la kahinorok memen.
Ri ma namkukuru, nadedem namkuru a'alam, la ma nomun manha, nadedem nomun a'alam.

Maa, ika eniyeni minle ropropo de kahinorok memen, leke kamkene lernohi Makromod Lalap, la karamyaka ri namehin, ono ik kauroin kokkoo nahenia ik lernala Makromod Lalap Nina or'ori dardari ma kan horu eni. Onne namwali iknika ilak raa kodi kadiyaka ika leke yon kadiyaur metmetek kalkaleni.
Makromod Lalap kan nili ika leke hukum ika, maa An nili ika leke ik Makromod Yesus Kristus huri we'er ika nano dohohala nin molollo.
An maki nahinerre maika leke rakan Nina lere alam mamai eni, lo'o ik mormori makun, ee ik makiyedi me'e, ik mori wali'ur koro Ai minwuku.
Ende mi ida ma na'alapa ida akin, la ida ma na'ori honorok ida naise nadedem mim hihi'i eni.
Paulus nala nounaku ida woro'o wali'ur
Ai walin na'ahoru, ai mapanak mim horhawe ri man howok lolo mi herne kalarna. Ri onnenihe, Makromod niliyedi leke ramwali man panulu rala wanakuku wanayo'o ki mi.
Mim horhawa hi wawa'an la maramyaka hi modi aki man mou. Mi ida man holi wawa'an noro ida.
Ai mala nounaku ida woro'o wali'ur ai walinhe: Dadiyala ri ma naprehen howok, ma'alapa ri man akin tana, paku ri ma ka naruri, la yono pelek modi ahan ri.
Madiyaka leke yono mi modi ha yakyaka walha ha yakyaka. Mahehe leke ida man hi'i wawa'an ida noro idewe ri heri ri wali.
Ai mapanak mi akim nahuwa'anedi mamani,
la hi'i lir napanak mamani.
Inhawa-inhawa ma namwali lolo mi, wa'an me yaka, mapanak trimkasi Makromod Lalap. Onne namwali Ainin panaeku ai walinhe ma nadinu'ul nakinaliyedi noro Yesus Kristus me'e.
Yono kawala Roh Kudus Nin honowok.
Yono ma'idaru Makromod Lalap Lirna man rin loikaru ki mi eni,
maa koklolo ma'inau loloi kakaru onne na'akeme leke mauroin ewi man wa'an noro ewi man yaka. Lernohi man wa'an,
la kemenedi man yaka na'akeme.

Ya apanak ik Makromod Lalap man hi'i ik akin namkene, hi'i ai walinhe pu'ik heli mehe Ai. Ya apanak An ilitolle mi honorok akin, mi irhum raramne, noro mi ihin kemen leke rakan lere Makromod Yesus wali mai, minim salida kaale.
Makromod Lalap man poluwedi mi me'e, mehen hi'i ha onne namwali, ono Ai namkene hi'i Nin nou na'akeme namwali.
Ai mapanak ai walin na'ahoru, yono hamlinu mayai lolo minim lir napanak.
Modi ainima tape masi rakanala ai walin ma akin naili'il Yesus na'ahoru lolo onne.
Yo odi Makromod Lalap Nin molollo apanak an'anhedi loikaruwala horok deudeul tantana eni laa ik walin ma akin naili'il Yesus na'akeme.
Ya apanak ik Makromod Yesus nala Nin rere'e haharu ki mi. Ainima tape masi, Paulus
